title: Command line crash course (MDN Learn web development, Environment setup)
why_trusted: MDN Web Docs, the reference for the web platform, hosts this Environment setup article; the live page says it was last modified on Sep 12, 2026 and lists the article's own learning outcomes for the terminal, basic commands, options and pipes.

title: User and workspace settings in Visual Studio Code
why_trusted: Official VS Code documentation on code.visualstudio.com; the live page lists the setting scopes and their precedence (default, user, remote, workspace, workspace folder, policy) and says workspace settings live in .vscode/settings.json.

title: Node.js Releases (release statuses, LTS schedule and installation methods)
why_trusted: The Node.js project's own release page; it names each major version's status (Alpha, Current, LTS, EOL) with first-released and last-updated dates, and states that production applications should only use Active LTS or Maintenance LTS releases.

title: The Missing Semester of Your CS Education
authors: Anish Athalye, Jon Gjengset, Jose Javier Gonzalez Ortiz (MIT)
why_trusted: MIT's public IAP course on developer tools, taught by MIT instructors with lecture notes, recordings and exercises freely available; the 2026 edition teaches the shell, command-line environment, development environment and version control.

title: Set up Git
why_trusted: GitHub's official setup page on its own domain: the install, identity and authentication steps that GitHub requires before a developer can push to a repository.

title: nvm-sh/nvm
why_trusted: The reference implementation of Node version management: a POSIX bash script (MIT) owned by the nvm-sh organisation with 96,173 stars, tests and GitHub Actions CI, and Google Cloud Shell ships it as a pre-installed tool (Google Cloud 'How Cloud Shell works', last updated 2026-11-10).

title: ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh
authors: Oh My Zsh project (ohmyzsh organisation, founded by Robby Russell)
why_trusted: The reference zsh configuration framework: MIT-licensed, owned by its own organisation, 190,639 stars with pushes on 2026-11-16, and the Microsoft-maintained Dev Container Features collection ships an installOhMyZsh option in ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/common-utils.

title: openai/codex
why_trusted: OpenAI's own Apache-2.0 terminal coding agent, the source behind the official Codex CLI documented at developers.openai.com/codex/cli; an active organisation-owned product (135,813 stars, last push 2026-11-19) that its owner ships to users, not a demo.

title: Pro Git
why_trusted: The official, freely available Git book, published on the Git project's own site.
